rows.ARS:
Pink blend Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: MACturang
Exhibition name: Maria McGredy
rows.Origin:
Bred by Samuel Darragh (1932-2019) McGredy IV (1990).
Introduced in New Zealand by Egmont Roses in 1998 as 'Maria McGredy'.
rows.Bloom: Pink blend, cream reverse. Salmon-pink & apricot, can fade. Sometimes split or confused centers.. Mild fragrance. 40 petals. Average diameter 4.5". Full (26-40 petals), borne mostly solitary bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Tall. Large, dark green foliage.

Height: up to 4'11" (up to 150cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 7b and warmer. Can be used for exhibition. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that. Requires spring freeze protection (see glossary - Spring freeze protection) .
rows.Breeder's notes: Maria McGredy - Macturang. Nicknamed Turangi. For my daughter.
rows.Parentage:
Freude ® (hybrid tea, Kordes, 1974) ×
Remember Me ® (hybrid tea, Cocker 1979)
rows.Notes: This rose is named for the breeder's daughter.
